Name: Cheesemonger - Cheese Making Expanded
Author: chocolatte12
Description:
[size=3]Cheese Making Process
[/size]
Make cheese curdles by putting milk and rennet into the cheese curdler!
﻿Rennet is collected from cows and goats!

Combine cheese curds and bacteria to the cheese press to make artisan cheese!
﻿Bacteria is collected from regular cheese making. You can grow more bacteria by putting it in the fermenter. Different bacteria makes different cheese!


[size=3]Machines

[/size]To get the machines: [spoiler]Ship 20 regular cheese and 20 goat cheese. You'll receive a letter with the recipes.[/spoiler]


9 unique cheeses added! Try gifting cheeses! Villagers love different cheeses, and some of them even have unique dialogue! 

[size=3]Compatibility
[/size]
If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38862]Flexible Cooking[/url], cheeses from this mod can be used as cheese in cooking recipes.
Should be compatible with all mods.

Manifest.Description: Adds in some more cheeses and expands on the cheesemaking process!
